authorization: One short DeepInfra video generation, up to USD 1. No automatic submission retry. Two explicit validation refusals preceded one accepted five-second generation. Duration increased only after the native validator rejected two seconds. Credential stored only in ignored Starport .env.
findings: OpenAPI declares asynchronous /v1/videos and /v1/openai/videos routes; native-only inference cannot be assumed for the provider.
Asynchronous request seconds is an integer; the current Starport request serializes a string.
Asynchronous response schema declares no measured duration or cost; it does not specify the status vocabulary.
OpenAPI declares no DELETE or cancellation route for these jobs.
A live POST for Wan-AI/Wan2.2-T2V-A14B returned HTTP 400 explicitly rejecting asynchronous jobs for this model and naming the native inference route.
A native request with two seconds returned HTTP 422 requiring five seconds, despite the model page advertising two or five seconds.
One native five-second generation returned HTTP 200 after 268.769 seconds.
The provider reported cost USD 0.375 and output_length 5. The response carried MP4 bytes as a base64 data URI.
A catalog entry must distinguish synchronous native generation from asynchronous job support for the selected offering.
ffprobe measured an H.264 1280x720 container at 16 fps and 5.062012 seconds. The provider billed output_length 5; container duration must not replace the provider billing quantity.

error.message: Wan-AI/Wan2.2-T2V-A14B does not support asynchronous video jobs. Use POST /v1/inference/Wan-AI/Wan2.2-T2V-A14B, which returns the video in the response.

limitations: No assertion that every DeepInfra video model uses the same transport.
No inferred zero charge from validation failure. No accepted job or generated video in either rejection.
Complete catalog selection, billing, adapter, durable execution, cancellation and recovery remain unqualified.
Provider-reported cost is not an independently reconciled account invoice.
One model and request do not qualify every duration, price selector, model, cancellation state, or failure charge.
The direct probe bypassed Starport. It does not qualify Starport dispatch or recovery.
